## 5. WATCH BUT DON'T TRADE

**AAPL:** Low HV rank (57) with compressed IV (23.8%) offers insufficient premium; wait for vol expansion.

**GOOGL:** Low HV rank (39) and earnings in 37 days creates awkward timing for 24+ DTE trades; skip for now.

**OKLO / TEM / PLTR:** High-risk tickers with erratic IV and thin liquidity; premium attractive but tail risk too elevated for core portfolio.

**SHOP:** Mid-tier HV rank (46) but below both MAs with 50-day earnings risk; better opportunities elsewhere.

**GILD:** Illiquid strikes with erratic IV patterns (e.g., $118P @ 43.3% IV vs $119P @ 28.4% IV); skip until normalization.
